Third, Theo — I confirm your report: privacy counsel has identified two mandatory conditions for any customer notices — account identifiers must be excluded, and the plan must include a dedicated toll-free response line.

Given all three reports, the current draft is not in a condition I can approve. The draft must be revised to reflect the reconciled overcharges, propose appropriate restitution, and include a customer-notice plan that satisfies the client's 21-day plain-language requirement and privacy counsel's two mandatory conditions. Marcus, please update the draft accordingly. I will not approve submission until those revisions are made and we've reviewed the updated package.
